decisions.rationale: It preserves all project-specific guidance: grounded naming, outcome-first ordinary handoffs, and the incident-order exception. It is slightly less compact but materially more complete and scoped.

It correctly represents lifecycle state by distinguishing retained naming and incident guidance from the newly added ordinary-handoff structure. The second alternative restates instructions instead of recording what changed and omits naming continuity.

limitations: Expected answers and condition identity were withheld, so the judgment relies only on the supplied persona summary and scenario.
